BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsêydâh is the word for food, provision. In Genesis 27:3, take me some venison, and it appears again in Exodus 12:39.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe tsêydâh still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
